Function-valued `ToolDefinitionSource` definitions are compiled only once at `register` time rather than resolved and cached via a `WeakMap` per `execute` call, violating a core functional requirement. In `registry.ts`, `(err as any).dataPath` violates the strict no-`any` linting rule, the required one-line JSDoc comment on `execute` is missing, and `import Ajv from 'ajv'` (instead of `import {Ajv} from 'ajv'`) can fail under NodeNext ESM typechecking. Finally, most required unit tests in `registry.test.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` as well as documentation updates (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`) were never implemented.
